🏷️ 700c Fixie / Single Speed Rear Wheel w/ Cog & Tire
📦 Item ID: #WRC03

Single speed / fixie rear wheel featuring an X-Press aluminum rim and flip-flop hub. Equipped with a 19T stainless steel cog and a Continental Grand Prix 700x23c road tire. Shows cosmetic signs of use and rust on axle end/hardware, but fully functional.

🔧 Technical Specifications:

• Wheel Size: 28" / 700c (622 mm)
• Hub Type: Rear Flip-Flop (Fixed / Single Speed)
• Cog: 19T Stainless Steel CNC (1/8")
• Rim: X-Press Aluminium Rim Brake
• Rim Width: 20 mm external (~15 mm internal)
• Tire: Continental Grand Prix 700x23c

🚴 Ready to inspect and pick up in Copenhagen. No shipping – personal pickup only in 2300 Copenhagen S. MobilePay accepted.
